page.title: Tax declarations
page.subtitle: What your accountant filed each quarter, checked against the books.
page.ownerOnly: Only the owner can see the tax declarations.

stats.quarters: {count, plural, one {# quarter} other {# quarters}} in the table

flags.title: To look at
flags.subtitle: Gaps between the declarations and the books. Checked one? Mark it as known.
flags.reopenConfirm: Reopen this flag and remove your note?
flags.notePlaceholder: Why it stands, when to recheck
flags.changed: Figure changed since your note (was {was}). Check again.
flags.provisionalPart: {amount} is at a provisional rate, so the gap may still change.

notDeclared.title: {period}: the books show {amount} more sales than the VAT declaration
notDeclared.body: Part may be timing or exchange rates. Ask your accountant if the rest should be declared.

declaredMore.title: {period}: the VAT declaration shows {amount} more sales than the books
declaredMore.body: Usually exchange rates, or an invoice dated in a different quarter from the payment. Check if it keeps growing.

missingReturn.title: {period}: no {form} recorded here
missingReturn.body: Filed? Record it with its PDF. Not needed? Mark it as known.

creditChain.title: {period}: [22] doesn't match the credit carried from last quarter
creditChain.body: [22] is {actual}, but last quarter's [43] carried {expected}. A typo, an unrecorded supplement, or an adjustment in [37]/[38]?

math.title: {form} {period}: line [{code}] doesn't add up
math.body: The form's formula gives {expected}, not {actual}. Check against the filed PDF.

bhxhNoStaff.title: {period}: social insurance paid, but no employees on the PIT declaration
bhxhNoStaff.body: BHXH paid this quarter: {amount}, but 05/KK-TNCN shows 0 employees. Who is insured, and is a salary paid?

bhxhMonthMissing.title: {month}: no BHXH contribution found
bhxhMonthMissing.body: No BHXH payment for {month} in the imported statements. Paid? Import that statement. Not paid? Ask your accountant — late payment can incur interest.

filedLate.title: {form} {period}: filed after the due date
filedLate.body: Filed {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}} late (due {date}). Ask your accountant about a late-filing penalty.

notFiled.title: {form} {period}: due {date}, not marked as filed
notFiled.body: Overdue by {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}. Filed? Add the date and PDF. Not filed? Ask your accountant.

returns.title: Declarations by quarter
returns.subtitle: Key lines of the latest filing per quarter. Open one for all lines and files.
returns.supplements: {count, plural, one {# earlier filing} other {# earlier filings}}

compare.title: Books vs declarations
compare.subtitle: Sales in the books each quarter vs sales declared in [34].
compare.none: Record a VAT declaration to compare it with the books.

form.figuresHint: Whole numbers; leave blank for 0. Only [36] can be negative (brackets or minus).
form.valueColumn: Value of goods and services (before VAT)
form.filesHint: PDF, XML, Excel, ZIP or images. Only you can open them.
form.deleteConfirm: Delete the {form} declaration for {period} and its files? This can't be undone.

gtgt.37: Adjustment down of VAT credit from earlier periods
gtgt.38: Adjustment up of VAT credit from earlier periods
gtgt.41: VAT credit not used this period

tncn.17: of which residents with a labour contract
tncn.24: of which life / voluntary insurance premiums paid to insurers not established in Vietnam
tncn.25: Exempt under oil and gas contracts
tncn.32: of which PIT withheld on those insurance premiums

errors.figure: Line [{code}]: whole numbers only (only [36] can be negative).
errors.duplicate: A {form} declaration for {period} with that supplement number is already recorded.
errors.gone: That record no longer exists — reload the page.
errors.fileType: {name}: only PDF, XML, Excel, ZIP or image files.

page.disclaimer: Your record of what was filed, typed from the PDFs. Flags are questions for your accountant, not conclusions.

compare.subtitle: Books count income that is reviewed or posted, in VND. Bank interest is financial income (TK 515), not sales, so it has its own column.
compare.note: Books follow payment dates and each entry's rate; declarations follow invoice dates and rates. Differences are shown, never offset.
